releaseScope: Architecture 3.2 P5: implement the native MCP SSE adapter required to call the real Burp MCP Server without treating its GUI JAR as a CLI.
changes: declaration derives mcp-proxy and native-tools-list from manifest.transport.protocol/capabilityAttestation without widening the published connector/v1 overlay schema.
mcp-sse opens a fresh same-origin SSE session, performs initialize/initialized, and dispatches tools/list/tools/call; session tokens stay in memory.
native tool names and per-tool input schemas are checked against the frozen recipe runtime.tools list; pending capabilities refuse before dispatch.
MCP results use the existing ai-software-call/v1 response, evidence, idempotency and platform-local lock machinery.
unchanged: No engine contract, error code, software body or credential provider shape changes.
publishedBy: qoder, architecture 3.2 P5 Burp native MCP closure
pointerPolicy: _connector 1.0.4 can be selected by its own current pointer; the Burp software pointer remains 1.0.0 until separately authorized.
migration: The platform connector must use 1.0.4 or newer to dispatch a recipe whose transport.protocol is mcp-sse; existing CLI and credential calls remain wire-compatible.
